subject.title: [Feature]: Merge iOS Privacy and Location card state

question: Should Settings > Privacy collapse the current Location-derived Privacy summary into the Location card with the requested Location Sharing and Access Level controls?
rationale: The duplicate state is source-proven, but changing from a segmented picker to switch/value-row controls is visible iOS UX direction that should be accepted by an iOS/product owner before automation edits it.

options.title: Approve Narrow Card Merge
options.body: Remove the standalone Location-derived Privacy status card, keep Location as the single state owner, and require focused tests for the new card contract.

options.title: Keep Current Segmented UI
options.body: Leave the issue open only if maintainers want the existing Privacy summary plus segmented Location picker preserved for a broader redesign later.

options.title: Defer To Broader Location Work
options.body: Track only desired/effective permission and background-location policy in broader location issues while leaving this duplicate-card cleanup unresolved.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Card Merge
recommendation.body: Remove the standalone Location-derived Privacy status card, keep Location as the single state owner, and require focused tests for the new card contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and merged Privacy Settings work point to steipete as the best available owner for this iOS Settings UX direction.
